skidSpec.title: Reference Skid v1.0 (draft, seeking independent P.E. review)
skidSpec.summary: A draft, open-source bill of materials for a modular closed-loop direct-to-chip cooling block, written from an IT/infrastructure operations perspective. It has not been reviewed or stamped by any engineer. It is published so independent water and mechanical engineers can critique it before anyone relies on it.

layers.spec: Redundant variable-speed pumps (e.g. Grundfos CRE), a liquid-to-liquid plate heat exchanger, a strainer, and dry-cooler heat rejection instead of an evaporative tower.
UF pre-filtration and an RO element (e.g. DuPont FilmTec BW30-400) for fill and makeup water. Target water-quality limits to be set by a reviewing engineer.
Inhibited propylene glycol (e.g. DOWFROST HD) or inhibited water, with inline pH/conductivity monitoring (e.g. Walchem W900) exporting over open protocols such as Modbus.
A checklist a town or zoning board could ask applicants to complete, covering expected WUE, discharge, and annual water use. Not yet written or reviewed.
